interruption.recovery: rerun frozen quality pass from verified baseline; no raw ingestion repeated

final_gate_failure.fix: Permit explicit minor-source validation gaps; fail missing required or major sources; recompute coverage in the planner.
final_gate_failure.regression_validation: PASS: 1479-test full suite including real span removal, mandatory coverage, incomplete accounting, alias minima, failure diagnostics and planner binding.

validation_coverage.scope: Measured final source coverage. Train-only minor categories have no source-specific held-out quality estimate; contaminated validation is never restored.

full_scan_report.scope: Original full scan before additive admission; preserved for initial spot-check evidence.

remaining_acceptance: Measured H200 probe after GPU is connected: memory, BF16/backend, throughput, disk and 168-hour budget.
Production trained-model evaluation and independent native language review.
limitations: Hardware and model quality are not inferred from CPU tests.
A bounded lexical near-duplicate search cannot certify absence of every semantic duplicate.
SFT is a small seed set, not evidence of broad instruction capabilities.
GGUF/vLLM remain unsupported for the native architecture; verified reference HF export is provided.
Final admission is a conservative whole-row subset; 44 reviewed retained documents are a sample, not proof that every corpus row is defect-free.
books_clean_v2 is a minor train-only source without source-specific held-out quality evidence.
The H200 profiles are candidates; neither optimal size nor achievable throughput is established before the hardware probe and validation.

next_steps: Transfer verified source/data archives to the H200 server.
Install pinned GPU runtime, restore data, recreate local plan, run the matching H200 probe, then execute.

additional_preparation_findings.problem: A minor source lost all validation rows after contamination removal; strict source-set equality rejected the complete generation.
additional_preparation_findings.resolution: Explicit source coverage: minor train-only gaps are reported; major or required gaps and incomplete source counts fail. Planner independently recomputes the proof. Failed finalization writes durable diagnostics.

additional_preparation_findings.problem: Post-trim minimum text length bypassed source aliases, using 30 characters for full Wiki sources instead of the configured 400/200.
additional_preparation_findings.resolution: Post-trim checks use shared source_rule; full-finalizer regressions exercise both aliases.

additional_preparation_findings.problem: Agent spot-check found malformed machine-translation-like prose in 7 of 24 sampled FineWeb2/HPLT documents, plus template-heavy pages. Automated language gates did not exclude these.
additional_preparation_findings.resolution: Reviewed additive policy applied as exact whole-row subset; all expected row/character totals and inherited lineage verified on actual published corpus. Final reviewed 44-document retained sample has no material defects; residual noise and no native-speaker approval are explicit.

additional_preparation_findings.problem: prepare_h200_tokenizer.prepare changed global NANOCHAT_BASE_DIR, redirecting later runtime reads to deleted temporary fixtures.
additional_preparation_findings.resolution: Tokenizer and SFT operations already take explicit paths; removed the unnecessary global environment mutation. Actual preparation tests verify preservation of both set and unset caller selections.
